title: HH-60 to the Rescue
description: Airmen with the 455th Expeditionary Aircraft Maintenance Squadron fix and maintain the Sikorsky MH-60G/HH-60G Pave Hawk, to make sure they're fleet is ready to go at all times.
keywords: HH-60, Carlos Martinez, 455 aew, Aviation News, Scott Snodgrass, Afghanistan, Bagram

transcript.text: We're in Bagram Afghanistan and my job out here is basically to maintain these helicopters
Specifically my job is to preventative maintenance every couple days
We have to do a pre-flight inspection that involves 130 steps and then once the pre-flight is accomplished anything we found broken
We have to fix it and if nothing's broken and everything's good
Then we have to do it with a call an H3
Hover check hit check and a hoist check and once that is accomplished
Then the aircraft returns to alert status if anything happens they'll call us and we'll be out there ready to go
My job is to be a communication navigation mission specialist for the H860
My mission in particular is to make sure that this aircraft is
Fully mission capable that all the radios are working as they should that all the navigation equipment is working as they should
My job here is different than back home because back home all we do is training missions
Sometimes we might get a real call out to real world
You know hikers somebody somebody they got lost out in the Grand Canyon something like that where we can actually go in and perform the rescue
However here we're constantly on alert. We're constantly on our toes if a car comes out
We're ready to jet out the door and get this aircraft up and rolling
